output.reason: The release note [ev-3f84c56f02fe] is vague by itself, and all four proposals only read that line. The linked PR is concrete, though. [ev-8f96659f6232] says the change brings back the `amiFamily` field on the karpenter.k8s.aws/v1 EC2NodeClass. If you use an alias, `amiFamily` is optional and is taken from the alias (e.g. al2023@latest gives AL2023). Setting `amiFamily: Custom` with an alias picks AMIs from the alias but does not merge Karpenter's UserData. [ev-861fe889b810] says `amiFamily` is now required when amiSelectorTerms are not aliases (e.g. `id:`). This gives the subject (the EC2NodeClass spec.amiFamily field), the change (what the field means, and new required-field validation), who is exposed (v1 EC2NodeClasses with non-alias amiSelectorTerms and no amiFamily), and what happens to them (the required-field check fails, backed by the changed CRD and CEL validation test files in [ev-52be2025a061]).
